answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 18543 Country: India Title: Obtaining certificate without appearing in examination Question: mere ek dost ne, paise dekar certificate banai hai,hala ke usne uska koi imtihan nahi diya. kya yeh jayaz hai... aur kya iske balbute par jo job lagta hai, uski kamaii halal hai ya haraam. lekin woh apne kaam main mahir hai. Answer ID: 18543 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 10/10/L=1431) Obtaining certificate without appearing in examination is unlawful, but his income will not be regarded haram if he gets a job on its basis provided he is fit for the job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
